headline: South Korea Inflation Rises Less Than Expected in October
summary: South Korea's Consumer Price Index (CPI) grew less than expected in October.
why: Consumer price inflation is a primary metric for central banks when evaluating monetary policy adjustments and interest rate decisions. Slower-than-expected inflation in South Korea can influence the Bank of Korea's policy stance.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: Lower consumer price inflation affects expectations for the country's macroeconomic conditions and monetary policy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A lower-than-expected CPI reading suggests easing inflationary pressures, which can alter interest rate expectations set by the central bank.
